messages.subject: ShinyApps.io License Question
parts:
I heard about ShinyApps.io when it first came out, however I was not ready to make use of it until now. My fuzzy memory tells me that alls ShinyApps.io are Free and Open Source, visible to the public, or something like that (?).

I've been trying to confirm that this morning by reading the website, but I can't find anything which confirms or denies it.

If I am correct that ShinyApps.io doesn't allow private/propriatary apps and I wanted to try developing one which is private-for-now then do I just need to use regular hosting services such as AWS, GoDaddy, etc. or is there an alternative which is more like ShinyApps.io? If I'm correct about ShinyApps.io being for public apps/code only then if that's analogous to a Github repo then what I'm hoping for is the equivalent of a a private Github repo.

Thanks!

J

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] ShinyApps.io License Question
parts:
Hi Jason,
Your memories are partially correct.  Once the service moves out of Beta, the free tier will not support authenticated applications.  That would be a paid tier that you could consider if you were interested in hosting your application on shinyapps.io. The first paid tier to support authentication that would be the $99/month or $1100/year tier.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to drop me a line and we can discuss your needs offline.

-Tareef
